name: Tighten
description: Declarative preset for cutting slack while preserving voice and necessary turns. Host application is not implemented.
purpose: Remove repetition, throat-clearing, and process that does not change character or plot.
writing_goals: Collapse process into summary where no character change occurs
Keep distinctive diction and load-bearing turns
constraints: Do not cut the cost of a decision
Do not homogenize sentence length into a monotone
checklist: No consecutive paragraphs make the same claim
Each remaining scene still has a job
